title: Bugfix/spark 2.4.4
description:
This PR adds support for Spark 2.4.4 by adding it to the versions.js file. I've model this PR on similar PRs that added support for new versions of spark like #38 .

In addition to this I've also updated the versions.js that lives in the R package so that it is up to date with the common/versions.js.

title: Fixes and features to prepare for CRAN release
description:
1. Ported fixes.
2. Polished `R CMD check` errors.
3. Added support for `paths` parameter to allow `sparklyr` users to keep using their existing Spark installations, we can't force them to un-install/install since they might have configured their install already so `sparkinstall` needs to support custom installation paths. New users or new Spark installs will benefit form shared paths between `R` and `Python`.

title: Copy install functions from sparklyr
description:
This PR copies all installation-related functions from `sparklyr` and makes available for this package:
- spark_available_versions
- spark_default_version
- spark_install
- spark_configure
- spark_install_dir
- spark_install_tar
- spark_installed_versions
- spark_uninstall

@brfealy @drdarshan @jmatthewsr-ms: I'm only using this PR to bring `sparklyr` installation and configuration functions. We can iterate over the `rappdirs::app_dir("spark", "rstudio")` and discuss other changes in subsequent PR, feel free to take the lead and propose the changes you have already identified with a new PR.

Since the intention is to support multiple language bindings, I would like to propose we prefix all commits with `[R]` for the r codebase, `[Python]` for Python, etc. This convention seems to be working well for https://github.com/wesm/feather/commits/master.
